text:
Where a vez the aguas of your rostro

giraron impulsadas for my hélices, sopla your áspero fantasma,

the muertos alzan the mirada;

where a day asomaron the pelo the tritones

a través of your hielo, the viento áspero navega

for the sal, the raíz, the huevas of the peces.


Where a vez your verdes nudos hundieron his atadura

in the cordón of the marea, there camina now

the vegetal destejedor,

with tijeras filosas, empuñando the cuchillo

for cortar the canales in his origen

and derribar the frutos empapados.


Invisibles, your mareas medidoras of the time

irrumpen in the camas galantes of the algas;

the alga of the love is vuelve mustia;

there in torno a your piedras

sombras of children van, that desde his vacío

lloran ante the sea colmado of delfines.


Secos as the tumba, your coloreados párpados

not serán aherrojados mientras the magia is deslice

sabia over the sky and the earth;

habrá corales in your lechos,

habrá serpientes in your mareas,

until that mueran all nuestros juramentos of the sea.

translation.title: Where a vez the aguas of your rostro
